dogecoin.text: @gate_io @dogecoin $DOGE has a total market value of more than $40 billion, adding up to $20 billion in the past 24 hours, according to crypto market data site CoinGecko. In last Friday (April 16) trading its digital code hit an all-time high at 32 cents, more than doubling in price from a day ago.

@kucoincom So far, despite its birth as a joke, Dogecoin has a market cap of nearly $40 billion, ranking 7 in the entire market in value terms, according to CoinmarketCap.  The digital currency has tripled in the past week.
#DogeDay #DogeKuCoin

@binance @Tesla A series of smaller-cap cryptocurrencies #Bitcoin  also increased sharply, causing the market to cover the green color. In which Ethereum increased 11.7%, Binance Coin increased 6.5%, Ripple increased 30.8%, Cardano increased 15%, Dogecoin increased 9.8%, Polkadot increased 13.8%
